description: Unique ThermoTrace M3 Spatio-Temporal Thermal Event Identifier
calculation_method: Aggregated via M3 spatio-temporal clustering engine (DBSCAN + temporal tracking)

description: UTC timestamp of the earliest satellite detection in the event cluster
calculation_method: min(acq_date + acq_time) across clustered FIRMS detections

description: UTC timestamp of the latest satellite detection in the event cluster
calculation_method: max(acq_date + acq_time) across clustered FIRMS detections

description: Weighted spatial centroid longitude of the event cluster
calculation_method: FRP-weighted mean longitude of member detections

description: Maximum spatial diameter bounding the detection coordinates
calculation_method: Maximum pairwise Haversine distance between member detections

description: Total number of satellite detections aggregated into this event
Number of distinct observing satellite sensors

description: Comma-separated list of observing platforms
